'''Mueum''' was a [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] hive. It was [[dartship]]s from this hive that severely damaged a [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] [[Chiss Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] in the space around [[Qoribu]].
